value.rationale: The canonical minimal symmetric planar 3-connected graph has face cycles of index 2 and a nonsplit integral S4 extension invisible to known Betti counts/rational characters. This identifies a natural geometric integral module as the dual D4 root lattice rather than the signed permutation lattice, offering a structural obstruction for symmetry-based two-particle topology.
